def solve(case):

        N = 0
        M = 0

        M = len(matrix[0]) if N>0 else 0

    # compute IDF using smoothing: idf = log(N / (1 + df))

        idf = [0.0]*M
    else:
        idf = [math.log(N / (1 + d)) for d in df]  # natural log
    # weighted matrix

    for i, row in enumerate(matrix):
        for j, val in enumerate(row):
            if val == 1:  # only non-zero weights
                weighted_matrix[i][j] = idf[j]
            # else stays 0
    # row_degree
    row_degree = [sum(row) for row in weighted_matrix]
    # return as dict
    return {
        "idf": idf,
        "row_degree": row_degree,
        "weighted_matrix": weighted_matrix
    }
